archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury merged with Archetype 4: Swiss High-Contrast (Luxury Medical Minimalism)
emotional_tone: Sophisticated, modern, organized, elegant, premium, international-grade.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headings to maintain the Apple/Linear aesthetic. Do not use 'Inter' for headings.

body.usage: Use leading-relaxed for long texts and dense tracking for metadata/labels.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (Control Room) for dashboards. Very clean, high density but breathable.
layout_and_spacing.gap_strategy: gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboards, ensuring every pixel feels intentional.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat, 1px solid border matching the theme's border color, slight rounded-2xl or rounded-xl corners. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Focus on optical clarity.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Linear-style sleek sidebar, thin borders, hover states using very subtle background shifts, muted icons.

surfaces.sticky_header: Glassmorphism Crystal: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), with a 1px delicate inner stroke on the bottom.
surfaces.dashboard_widgets: Neumorphism/Flat: Matches parent background lightly, sharp inner contrast. Use 1px border-black/5 or border-white/10.
surfaces.modals_dialogs: Heavy blur backdrop, crisp solid background for the modal itself.

components.general: Heavily customize Shadcn components. Strip the Vercel look by applying custom radii and replacing black/white solid buttons with the sophisticated rose gold/champagne palette.
components.agenda_calendar: Must feel like a premium Google Calendar. Support drag-drop (if possible or visual indicators of it), color-coding by status, multiple practitioners. Use standard HTML/CSS grid for custom calendar layouts if Shadcn isn't flexible enough.
components.forms: Minimalist borders, floating labels or very clean standard labels, highlight input rings with primary colors on focus.
components.icons: lucide-react (1.5px stroke weight for premium thin aesthetic).

animations.strategy: Framer Motion. Subtle page load fades (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0 over 0.4s). Micro-interactions on buttons and card hovers.

login_backgrounds.usage: Use as full-screen cover on the login page for multi-profile selection. Must look incredibly high-end.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to ensure the 'Luxury Medical Minimalism' vibe. Avoid standard blue/green healthcare themes.
Implement the UI in Portuguese (pt-BR) as requested.
Build the dashboard using a cardless or ultra-flat rectangle style, avoiding heavy shadows or generic ERP appearances.
Implement a theme toggle (Light/Dark) that feels premium. The dark mode should lean on deep blacks and graphite, not blue-greys.
For the Prontuário Digital (Medical Record), use split views or side-by-side components to allow 'before and after' image comparison seamlessly.
Ensure all interactive elements and key text nodes contain 'data-testid' attributes for testing.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Stick to 'Outfit'.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the dashboard layout grid, mapping directly to Bento Grid Mode B.
Build a premium Sidebar Navigation inspired by Linear/Notion: collapsible, clean typographic hierarchy, muted active states.
